mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.group_name, g.glft, g.grht, g.group_level FROM sys_group_except_entrust ge INNER JOIN sys_group g ON ge.group_except_entrust_id = g.id WHERE ge.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} and ge.perm_id = #{permId,jdbcType=CHAR} and ge.org_id = #{orgId,jdbcType=CHAR}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_group_except_entrust WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND perm_id = #{permId, jdbcType=CHAR} and org_id = #{orgId,jdbcType=CHAR}
